# Settings popup slices
Screen 1280x720 (mockup scale). x,y = top-left from TOP-LEFT; Cocos (bottom-left origin, anchor 0.5): (center x, 720 - center y).
Layer order: background -> panel_blank -> divider (reuse divider_dashed at y 229/303/373/444, same x) -> icons/labels -> controls -> plank buttons -> deco_mole_wrench.
Reassembly (contact_sheet_reassembly.jpg) vs mockup: mean abs diff shown in report.
States: toggle_on / toggle_off (off = mirrored on). segment_selected_blank (hatched) / segment_unselected_blank (plain) for either side; text_color (彩色) / text_bw (黑白) overlays. slider_knob (music) & slider_knob_sfx are both usable knobs; slider_track_* include their tick marks, knob removed by inpaint.
lang_box_blank = center box without text; text_lang_zh = '简体中文' text overlay (or use a Label).
plank_blank = 继续游戏 plank with text inpainted; icon_house separate (also baked in btn_back_to_title).
